text:
Nadia: Quick note from staging: pavo-embed-3 int8 (onnx static) shows recall@5 drop ~4.5% vs FP32 on semantic-sim. FP32 r@5=0.86 -> INT8 r@5=0.815.
Ravi: Oof. Is this across the board or concentrated?
Nadia: Mostly the medium-length cohort (12-30 tokens). Short (<10) and very long (>60) are ~flat.
Keisha: Could be calibration tail issues. What calibration method + samples?
Nadia: MSE calibration with 512 samples from the training corpus. Weight per-channel, activations per-tensor asymmetric. Export used default onnx opset.
Ravi: Two quick sanity checks: 1) FP16 run to see if reduced precision (not quantization) causes drop, 2) histogram/KL calibration with larger sample set.
Nadia: Started FP16 now, queueing KL+4k samples next. Also comparing cosine-norm distribution: fp32 mean=0.99 sd=0.12, int8 mean=1.01 sd=0.13. tiny up-shift.
Keisha: Small norm drift can change ranks at high precision. Can you paste a swap sample? top-5 for a failing query helps.
adia: Dump (trimmed):
```
qid: 12877
fp32_ranks: [(d_44,0.872),(d_12,0.865),(d_7,0.864),(d_90,0.862),(d_3,0.860)]
int8_ranks: [(d_12,0.868),(d_44,0.866),(d_7,0.860),(d_90,0.853),(d_3,0.849)]
notes: top1/top2 swapped, small cosine deltas ~0.003-0.01
```
Ravi: Looks like stable neighborhood but ranking jitter. If many swaps in top5, recall@5 will move. Run a PCA on embeddings and compare principal directions before/after to detect rotation.
Keisha: Also check whitening/centering pre/post quant. We saw earlier that dataset whitening amplifies small biases. Try eval with and without whitening to isolate.
Nadia: Good call. Will run four configs: FP32, FP16, INT8 (MSE,512), INT8 (KL,4096), each with and without whitening. Script I'm using:
```
./eval/bench_embeddings.sh --model pavo-embed-3 --modes fp32,fp16,int8_mse512,int8_kl4096 --whitening on,off --cohorts medium,short,long --out /tmp/pavo_int8_diag.log
```
eval-bot: Job 2471 queued by Nadia. ETA ~18m. Will post each job result here.
Ravi: If KL+4k + no-whitening recovers most of the gap, we can recommend that quant config for canary. If not, consider a light quant-aware finetune on medium-length samples.
Keisha: Also add silhouette and cluster purity metrics — r@k doesn't capture whether clusters are stretched. Small rank swaps can still degrade cluster cohesion.
Nadia: Adding silhouette, purity, and topk-flip-rate. Will share results. :rocket:
